meta.name: ecommerce-product-detail
meta.description: Extract complete product information from any e-commerce product page. Returns name, price, currency, brand, images, description, SKU/ASIN/EAN/UPC/GTIN/MPN identifiers, stock availability, rating, review count, variants, and seller. Works on Shopify, Amazon, WooCommerce, eBay, Walmart, Etsy, AliExpress, Alibaba, Target, Best Buy, Rakuten, Magento, BigCommerce, PrestaShop, and any public e-commerce site. Accepts product URL, keyword, or product identifier (SKU/ASIN/EAN/UPC). Use when: scrape product page, get product details, extract price and availability, product info extraction, check product data, product detail scraping, get product from URL, keyword product search, ASIN lookup, EAN search, UPC lookup, price check, product research, compare products, monitor product price, get product images, product brand and description, ecommerce data extraction, product catalog scraping, product page scraper, get item price, fetch product info.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任意电商页面提取完整商品信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从电商网站抓取商品详情和价格
copy.tagline_en: Extract complete product info from any e-commerce page
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to scrape product details and prices from e-commerce sites

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据商品链接、关键词或商品编号，提取商品名称、价格、品牌、图片、描述、库存、评分、评论数、变体、卖家等信息。
howto.when: 当你提供商品链接、关键词（如“iPhone 15”）、或商品编号（如 ASIN、EAN）时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下这个商品链接的详细信息。
say.note: Claude 会提取并展示商品数据。

say.text: 搜索“无线耳机”并返回前三个结果。
say.note: Claude 会搜索并列出商品。

say.text: 查一下 ASIN 为 B09WNK39JN 的商品。
say.note: Claude 会直接打开该商品页面并提取信息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can extract product details (name, price, brand, images, description, stock, rating, reviews, variants, seller) from any e-commerce product page using a URL, keyword, or product identifier.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a product URL, keyword (e.g., "iPhone 15"), or product identifier (e.g., ASIN, EAN).

say_en.text: Get me the details of this product link.
say_en.note: Claude will extract and display product data.

say_en.text: Search for "wireless headphones" and return top 3 results.
say_en.note: Claude will search and list products.

say_en.text: Look up the product with ASIN B09WNK39JN.
say_en.note: Claude will navigate to the product page and extract info.
